_about: Master section registry for En Garde Gazette (Frank 2026-10-20). Being configured section by section with Frank; CONTENT-HIERARCHY.md remains canonical until migration is complete. Readable table will be generated from this file.

fields.priority: core | high | medium | low (words, not numbers). core = never cut; low = first cut when long, first pulled in to fill when short. Within a tier, Desk uses judgment on the week. | dynamic (see priority_rule)
fields.size: min / typical / max that still reads well
fields.placement: page / column-span hints (priority, not page assignment)
fields.rules: house rules: section-specific notes and lines not to cross that other fields don't cover

sections.name: Lead Story
sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive: the week's biggest epee news
sections.supplier: desk finds and writes; frank vets at budget; Frank's tips count as sources
sections.lead_time: picked Monday after the weekend; can swap late if a bigger result posts
rules: Pick order: strong club result first, then national/NJ
A late big club result bumps the planned lead to a page-1 feature

sections.name: Club Results
sections.frequency_detail: only when there's a strong result or a qualification
sections.supplier: desk from FencingTracker/AskFRED; Frank's chat tips count; names as on official pages
sections.lead_time: as results post; keep checking until compose
rules: Strong results only (podium, top 8, notable climb)
Qualifying is the result (Frank 2026-10-20): whether someone qualified matters most, and it's sensitive; print 'qualified for X', placement not the headline (omit by default)
No 'also fenced' line; nobody embarrassed
No birth years; schools per global school rule

sections.name: Ratings Earned
sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive: ~2 weeks; late-posted ratings still count
sections.supplier: desk from FencingTracker/AskFRED; Frank's tips count
sections.lead_time: as ratings post; checked until compose
rules: Separate box from Club Results: worth celebrating on its own
Ratings earned ANYWHERE count (USA Fencing ratings are national)
Name the event the rating came from
Celebrate step-ups only; never mention drops
Names as on official pages

sections.name: Secondary Articles
sections.status: configured 2026-10-20; merges old Secondary A and B
sections.shelf_life: mostly time_sensitive; evergreen explainers can sit on the bench
sections.supplier: desk finds and writes; frank vets at budget
sections.lead_time: picked in Monday pass; Wednesday-skim leads carry over
sections.placement: any page, 1 column or 2 for a bigger piece
rules: First piece usually holds; a second is first to go when tight
Real news or a clear explainer, not just scores
Verified facts only; opinions labeled

sections.name: NJ High School Roundup
sections.frequency_detail: every issue in the winter HS season; off-season only for real news (preseason primer, rule change)
sections.supplier: desk from NJ.com, NJSIAA, school athletics pages; frank vets at budget
sections.lead_time: Monday pass covers the week's meets
rules: Whole-state coverage
Schools print per the global school rule (official results, relevant)

sections.name: Overheard on Reddit
sections.frequency_detail: best at one per issue, never forced; most of Reddit is junk
sections.supplier: frank shares Reddit threads as PDFs; desk picks and writes
sections.lead_time: whenever Frank sends; good ones wait on the bench
rules: No usernames
Opinions labeled as opinions; factual claims checked first
Optional one-line 'Fact check:'

sections.name: Nearby Tournaments
sections.supplier: desk from club schedule digest, FencingTracker registrations, AskFRED
rules: Elite FC entries only
Pending (unpaid/unconfirmed) entries print like confirmed
When tight: fewer tournaments before fewer names
Multi-day tournament = one block, days in order
No '(Epee)' labels

sections.name: Deadlines
sections.priority_rule: rises as deadlines approach: high if a deadline is within ~3 weeks, medium within ~6 weeks, low beyond; far-off deadlines print only if there's room
sections.frequency_detail: skips in quiet stretches (e.g. summer); a lone far-off deadline can ride as one line elsewhere (e.g. under Nearby Tournaments)

size.typical: follows how many deadlines are near

sections.supplier: desk from AskFRED, email, USA Fencing
sections.placement: adjacent to Nearby Tournaments when both run
rules: Entry closes and renewals (e.g. USA Fencing membership)
Dates checked against the official page

sections.name: Club Events
sections.priority_rule: by item type: club-hosted tournament = core (early heads-up ~4-6 weeks out, grows toward the date; real write-up or lead-size); urgent announcement (schedule change, closure) = high, print ASAP as a one-liner, drop once old news; camp/clinic = low 'save the date' early, rising to medium then high as signup closes (may repeat over issues); routine notes (regular class schedule) = low, one line at most
sections.frequency_detail: camps, special classes, schedule changes, club-hosted tournaments

size.max: small box with class table only when the schedule changes; club-hosted tournament can be lead-size

sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive until the event; camp reminders can repeat
sections.supplier: desk from club Mailchimp, Frank's forwards, chat
sections.lead_time: varies by type (see priority_rule); refreshed each weekly pass
sections.placement: any page, 1 column (club-hosted tournament can go bigger)
rules: Regular class schedule never as a table unless changed; one-line note preferred
No unpublished prices
Only the club's public contact details

sections.name: Parent Q&A
sections.frequency_detail: when Frank passes along a real parent's question

size.max: two Q&As if room after cuts

sections.supplier: frank passes the question; desk answers from official sources
rules: Anonymous by default; name only if the parent asks
No Frank byline
Distinct from For the Parents (nobody asked)

sections.name: By the Book
sections.priority_rule: low filler by default; may rise to medium when a rule is relevant that week (e.g. a controversial call)
sections.frequency_detail: filler: runs when there's space, no every-issue slot
sections.shelf_life: evergreen; keep a few on the bench
sections.supplier: desk from USA Fencing rulebook + penalty chart (reference/usa-fencing/), FIE when different; frank vets at budget; never wait on Frank for material
rules: Cite rule numbers; brief quotes; epee only
Never takes sides on a real call (that's Controversial Calls)

sections.name: For the Parents
sections.frequency_detail: every issue when there's a good topic; never forced
sections.shelf_life: mostly evergreen; seasonal topics (HS season, first NAC) time-sensitive
sections.supplier: desk researches; frank vets; Frank's ideas and club observations welcome
rules: For non-fencing parents: plain words, explain any jargon
One practical topic per piece, sourced
Proactive (nobody asked), unlike Parent Q&A

sections.name: Comic
sections.frequency_detail: sparingly, only when Frank or Ling send one
sections.supplier: frank or Ling draw and email it; desk never draws or writes it
rules: Guest artist (Ling) gets a credit line; Frank no byline
Must print well in B&W
Ling's credit wording still open

sections.name: Epee on Screen
sections.frequency_detail: major epee events streaming soon (World Cups, Grand Prix, Worlds, NACs)
sections.supplier: desk from FIE calendar, FencingTV, USA Fencing
rules: Where to watch only; no start times/prices unless the official page lists them
Short links only

sections.name: Club Photos (working name)
sections.frequency_detail: ideally paired with a story (camp, tournament, club event); or one standalone 'from the club' photo
sections.shelf_life: event photos time_sensitive; club-life shots evergreen
sections.supplier: club Instagram @elitefencersclub (coach approved 2026-10-20); desk fetches or Frank sends; desk picks, crops, B&W, captions
sections.placement: any page; beside the related story when there is one
rules: Source: club's own Instagram (instagram.com/elitefencersclub); kids' faces OK since the club posted them publicly
Credit one short line (e.g. 'Photo: Elite FC Instagram')
Names only from Frank or the post itself
No minors' personal accounts

sections.name: Featured Bout
sections.frequency_detail: semi-regular, roughly every 2-3 issues, when Frank has watched a bout worth recommending; never forced

size.max: ~250w in-depth review, only when the bout is exceptional

sections.shelf_life: evergreen while the video stays online
sections.supplier: frank (bout link + optional screenshot + his take); desk writes
sections.lead_time: a few days; can sit on the bench ready to fill
sections.placement: any page; 1 column, 2 if review-length with a screenshot
rules: Credit the video every time with a SHORTENED link (e.g. youtu.be/<id>), never the long URL
Screenshot only from Frank; check the video's usage terms before printing
Insights stay grounded in what's on the video; opinions labeled

sections.name: Travel Tournaments (working name; Road Trip dropped since half the trips are flights; Frank still choosing)
sections.status: new (2026-10-20), configuring; deliberate revival of travel, limited to national tournaments (the 2026-10-06 cut of general travel stands)
sections.frequency_detail: every national tournament (NACs, March NAC, Summer Nationals), ~4-8 weeks out; most club kids attend only Summer Nationals and the March NAC, older kids go to more, so those two get the fullest treatment
sections.shelf_life: time_sensitive: stale once the tournament passes
sections.lead_time: start ~6-8 weeks before the event so it can run 4-8 weeks out
sections.role: occasional feature; encourages families to travel to nationals
rules: Be very selective with places: skip anything a quick Google search would surface; favor few, non-obvious, season/weather-appropriate picks that fit a tournament schedule
Venue basics and practical tips for families
Facts sourced; no paid placements

sections.name: Photo from History
sections.role: filler: cheap content that looks deliberate
sections.frequency_detail: when there's room; at most one per issue
sections.supplier: Frank's research agent finds; desk picks, crops, captions; frank vets at budget
rules: Credit ONE short line: author/source, license+version, '(cropped)' if changed
Re-check blurb facts before printing
Photo need not show fencing (Frank 2026-10-18)
Keep the fair-play image (07) away from cheating stories

sections.name: Controversial Calls
sections.priority_rule: rises to high when the call involved our club or drew real attention
sections.frequency_detail: only a real disputed call; never manufactured
sections.supplier: desk researches from rulebook + verified facts; frank vets
sections.placement: any page; 2 columns as a feature
rules: Structure: the call / the rule / both sides (opinion labeled) / the verdict
Never name referees critically
Fencers named only with the family's OK

house_rules_global: Schools (Frank 2026-10-20): a high schooler's school may print when it appears on an official results page and is relevant (e.g. NJ HS roundup); otherwise leave it out. Never print a middle/elementary schooler's school. (Replaces the old 'Brendan's school never prints' caution, which was only about an unverified school.)
No Reddit/X usernames; no minors' personal accounts
